source.title: Cancellation of WCA North American Championship 2020
source.content:
It is with great sadness that we announce the cancellation of [WCA North American Championship 2020](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NA2020) due to the COVID-19 outbreak. Given the instability and uncertainty of the situation, the competition will not be postponed to a later point of the year. If you registered for this competition, you will be issued a refund that is due to be processed in the next couple of weeks. Please see the post [here](https://nachamps2020.com/cancellation) for the official cancellation from the competition organizers. 

We appreciate the community's kind understanding during this uncertain time.

translation.title: 2020 年 WCA 北美锦标赛取消
translation.content:
我们很遗憾地宣布，受新冠疫情影响，[2020 年 WCA 北美锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NA2020)取消。鉴于局势仍不稳定、充满不确定性，比赛不会延期至今年晚些时候举行。已报名选手将获得退款，预计在接下来几周处理。主办方的正式取消公告见[此处](https://nachamps2020.com/cancellation)。

感谢社区在这段充满不确定性的时期给予理解。
